titulo_seo: Motorsport services and activations — La Virage Club
descripcion_seo: Commissioned events, brand activations and services for motorsport clubs and organisers. Concept, production and delivery.

secciones.texto: WHATEVER GETS SOLD HAS TO BE BUILT. COMMISSIONED EVENTS, BRAND ACTIVATIONS AND SERVICES FOR CLUBS AND ORGANISERS.

secciones.subtitulo: ON THEIR OWN OR ALONGSIDE RIGHTS SALES

items.texto: A launch, a prize-giving. Whatever you need around a race, from the first idea to the get-out.
The brand at the rally, properly integrated: in the hospitality area, in an experience, at the table. Seen and remembered.
Hospitality areas, print and signage, hosting and coverage. The things your team never gets round to.

secciones.titulo:
The brand is there.
Done properly.
secciones.cuerpo:
An activation works when people live it, not when they walk round it. We build the brand into what happens over the weekend: in the hospitality area, in the experience, at the table and in what guests take home with them.

And on the banner, the board or the car door when it's called for, with the same care as everything else. Present, visible and properly integrated.

secciones.subtitulo: FROM THE FIRST IDEA TO THE GET-OUT

items.texto: The idea behind the event or activation, set design, invitation, menu and signage. We start with the why and the where.
Venue, permits, catering, lighting, sound and suppliers. Every element specified.
Hosting, music, photography and aftermovie. On the day, everything works.

secciones.subtitulo: THE FULL SCOPE · ADJUSTED TO EACH COMMISSION

items.texto: Finding the space, negotiating with the owners and handling the paperwork.
Dressing the space, furniture, the table and the get-out.
A menu built on local produce, a bar, front-of-house service and staff.
Lighting plan, audio kit, technicians and power.
Choosing and booking live music or a DJ, and setting the pace of the night.
Welcome, guest list and looking after people from start to finish.
Full coverage and an edited film for your own use.
Invitation, menu, signage and branded pieces. Produced and installed.
